description: §66.12.6 rule 3: `pop` and `shift` return the removed value, typed `T | not`, and §66.10: an alias taken before the edits keeps every element. On `[3, 4, 5]`, `xs.pop()` is 5 and `xs.shift()` is 3, leaving `[4]`; `before` still holds 3 elements. One #go click sets @n to (5 + 3 * 10) * 100 + 1 * 10 + 3 = 3513.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S469 "⭐ RULED — tape methods are named after their grants; JS array method names are refused" ("Names match the grants (Recommended)")
rationale: §66.12.6 rule 3: "`pop`, `shift` and `remove` return the removed value, typed `T | not`: on an empty tape, or a `remove(i)` with no position `i`, nothing is removed and the result is `not`"; §66.10 rule 1: "A binding … initialized from … any value holds a snapshot of that value."
